balls.text: oh dear, it's all over for Punjab. Bartlett wanted the second, but Arshdeep didn't and it was way too late for Bartlett to make his ground. Bartlett had backed away outside leg and swatted the ball towards long on, Venky fired the throw in from the deep and Bartlett was left stranded after a mix-up with Arshdeep.
short of a length outside off, Arshdeep flat-bats it to long on

lbw! Shashank has reviewed immediately but I think in hope more than anything else. He was moving forward and across his stumps to play the ball coming into him with a closed face on the leg side. Arora beat the inside edge and hit the front pad on the knee roll. That's hitting leg stump. Three reds and Punjab are nine down with 29 balls to go.
played gently to mid on to end the over
slower ball, short of a length and angling into the batter who was moving outside leg to make room, Bartlett gets beaten as he tries to swat at the ball
backs away again and swings in hope, the short of a length ball pings the top edge and soars over the wicketkeeper for a one-bounce four
clears his front foot towards the leg side and flat-bats a short of a length ball to mid-on where Russell makes the stop
backs away towards leg to make room to hit on the off, but Nortje follows him with a short of a length ball, played down into the leg side for a single
good length angling in to off stump, defended on the front foot back to the bowler
around the wicket, slanting across the right-hander, Shashank strides forward and nudges the ball into the leg side
leans forward and thumps it down the ground, for just the single
nudged into the covers off the front foot for a single
that is some shot from Shashank, down on one knee to launch the wide ball from outside off high and far over extra cover
full ball on middle and leg, driven firmly down the ground
hit hard, but into the pitch and right back at the bowler
hit down to long on for another single, Punjab scoring down to a trickle now
pushed off the front foot to long on
strays down leg side this time, Shashank misses the glance
an appeal for lbw but I think the impact on the pad is outside off stump, Shashank came forward and across to defend and missed
goes right back and defends with a straight bat to the bowler
driven off the front foot to long on for one more
played off the back foot towards the leg side, midwicket slides to cut off the shot around silly mid on, no timing at all
hit down the ground for a single to long on
played off the front foot to midwicket
full and straight, driven to long on for a single
worked off the pads in front of square
reaches for it awkwardly outside off and plays on the leg side
played off the back foot to point for a single
what on earth is Jansen doing? Steps out of his crease and tries to flick the ball through the legside, ends up yorking himself and Narine hits off stump
dabbed off the back foot towards deep third

he's taken him on! With the situation Punjab are in that too. Shashank lofts Narine high towards the cow corner boundary. Rinku has a lot of running to do to try and get to the ball and he can't make it. One bounce four.
moves forward and across and defends on the leg side
nudged gently off the front foot towards mid on
make that three wickets in hand! Shedge's gone. He tried to cut that and got a thick edge right into QDK's gloves, sharp catch that
proper front foot defence to end the over, bat close to front pad and everything
driven to long off for a single
goes back and across and nudges the ball off his pads through square, he's hit that softly so they have time to sprint the second before the fielder in the deep can prevent it
goes back and across and chips the ball that spins into him towards mid on
Shashank strides forward first ball and defends towards cover

bowled him! Maxwell had no idea what was happening there. Varun pitched the ball on a good length outside off and spun the wrong 'un back into the right-hander. Maxwell had come forward and then didn't know what to do, he tried to jam his bat down but was late on it, the ball spun between bat and pad and hit the stumps

150 kph! Short ball that catches Maxwell by surprise. He sways out of the way, letting the ball fly between him and the stumps. The pace takes QDK by surprise too as he dives to his left, gets some glove on it and the ball runs to fine leg
defended on the back foot on the off side, quick single
caught at deep square leg this time! Two fours and gone. He didn't have the space to free his arms properly while playing that pull shot, Venky Iyer ran to his right from long leg to take the catch.
fuller ball on a straighter line and Wadhera lofts it off his pads to the deep midwicket boundary

width outside off and Wadhera pounces, flaying the ball past point with a fierce cut shot, the ball speeds to the boundary. Ramandeep was the fielder diving to his left at point and it was just out of his reach
good length from over the wicket slanting across the left-hander, Wadhera watchfully defends from his crease
good length, angling into the right-hander's off stump, Maxwell presses forward and opens the face to play to point
slower ball outside off, looked like an offcutter and it kept low too, Maxwell tries to cut it but was beaten by the change of pace and lack of bounce
tries to cut a short of a length ball outside off and bottom edges it into the ground
dabbed watchfully towards point for a single
strays down leg side this time
What happened there? The short of the length ball held its line just outside off and beat Maxwell's defence on the back foot, QDK fumbled the take and Narine had to mop up on the deep third boundary
that is sublime timing from Maxwell, he just opened the face and steered a short of a length ball from outside off, placed it wide of deep third who had no chance to his right
short ball just outside off stump, and Maxwell lets it go! Is he tempting him into a slash with Ramandeep in the deep?
strides forward and punches the ball through point for one more
nudged off the front foot, gently to midwicket
a rather tame dab off the pads in front of square leg followed by a frantic dash between the wickets for the second run
worked off the pads to short fine leg for a single
reverse swat to backward point, can't find the gap in the in field
wicket to wicket line, played off the back foot towards the bowler

he's caught on the cut this time! The Rana-Ramandeep tag team KOs Prabhsimran. Short of a length with not much width outside off, Prabhsimran is cramped for room as he cuts and one hand comes off the bat as he makes contact, slicing the ball straight to the fielder at point
short of a length and wide outside off, Prabhsimran is beaten on the cut once again
down the track and bam! Launches the length ball over the long-off boundary with a full swing of his arms, he had to reach for it and made great connection
finally he makes contact, and that is some contact! Prabhsimran stays in his crease, shapes to cut, and then decides to use his bat like a ramp to ping the ball over the deep third boundary
this time the line is far too close to the body for the cut shot, he's beaten again
Rana is getting good bounce for his short of a length stuff outside off, Prabhsimran tries to slash it but misses
defended watchfully towards the bowler on the front foot

Iglis' debut innings is short lived! He wasn't having much of a sighter against Varun, went for the big slog sweep and missed. Varun barely celebrates after the ball clatters into the stumps. Punjab in some disarray now after that flurry of boundaries
dragged short on a wicket to wicket line, Inglis swivel pulls to fine leg
punched off the back foot to cover
Inglis tries to reverse swat Varun first ball! Appeal for lbw after he misses but the impact on the pad was outside off
dabbed to short third for a single
a much better ball to finish the over, short of a length, closer to the right-hander and with some extra bounce, Inglis tries to steer to deep third and gets beaten
short of a length and wide outside off, Inglis reaches for it and gets beaten on the cut

Shreyas falls for a second-ball duck! Rana is striking with some pretty average bowling! Short and wide outside off, such a hit-me ball, and Shreyas lashes the cut in the air towards deep third, where Ramandeep comes sprinting in and dives forward to take a superb catch inches from the ground
Rana has a bit of a smile at his former captain after beating him with a skiddy ball outside off stump, Shreyas tried to cut it but missed

caught at long leg! That's a lucky break for KKR, the ball was nothing special, length delivery pitching outside leg stump, Arya flicked it off his thigh but didn't follow through with power like he usually does. Ramandeep takes a straightforward catch on the boundary
too full and that's been smashed far over the long-off boundary, Arya had so much space to free his arms and use all his power
good length on leg and middle and swing towards the off stump, Arya stays in his crease and guides the ball to point
Arya charges this time and swats a short of a length ball over the head of the fielder at mid-on, boundaries coming in a glut for Punjab
he's charging the bowler so early! Arora sees him coming and shortens the length and cramps him for room, jabbed on the leg side for a single
Punjab are up and running now, Prabhsimran gives Arora the charge and smacks the ball up the up with a straight bat, blasting it between the bowler and mid off

helicoptered flat over the deep midwicket boundary! Arora pitches too full and too straight, Prabhsimran moves forward and across and lays into that delivery with an extremely powerful whip of the wrists
in the air but just beats the fielder at short fine leg! Prabhsimran moved across his stumps and scooped a length ball, flat and hard enough to beat Nortje to his right
slower ball on a short length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Arya drags the pull from outside off and lofts it wide of the fielder at mid-on
shorter length and closer to the body, Arya tries to flay it through the off side but gets beaten by the bounce
length ball, wide outside off, room for Arya to free his arms and launch it over extra cover ... stand and deliver stuff from the rookie, dispatched a 149kph delivery
slower ball at 127 kph, fuller length on the pads, Prabhsimran stays in his crease and tucks it through square leg
angled into the thighs this time and Prabhsimran tries to glance but doesn't make contact with the bat
148.6 kph right away! short of a length and quick just outside off stump, too quick for Prabhsimran who gets beaten on the cut
more swing for Arora from leg to off stump, Arya goes after this one, aiming for the loft down the ground, he ends up slicing it in the air over the infield at covers
gives him the charge first ball but the length is too short to attack it, ends up stabbing the ball towards cover and continues running through for a single
a fuller ball on off stump, pushed wide of mid off for a single
more swing, from leg and middle towards off stump from a good length, Arya plays his third consecutive defensive shot
Arora is getting it to move across the left-hander from over the wicket, on a wicket to wicket line, denying Arya room, he plays it from the crease towards the bowler
good length from over the wicket, pitching around middle and slanting across the left-hander, played off the front foot to point

Punjab have done it. The lowest total successfully defended in IPL history! And look at these scenes out in the middle, red shirts running in from far and wide to the pitch to mob their man Marco! Short of a length ball angled into the right-hander from around the wicket, Russel cleared his front foot and swung hard, inside edge on to the stumps. Good night! Absolutely sensational game this.

got him! Arshdeep has done it. He changes the angle and goes around the wicket and bangs in the short one straight at Arora's head, he backs away and fends at it and gloves it to Inglis. Punjab are one wicket away, but KKR have Russell back on strike.
short ball right at the body, Arora hangs his bat out in front of him and fends it away, the ball goes towards short third
fends and misses, to be fair he drew his bat away late from the short of a length ball angling across him
short ball from over the wicket and Arora ducks under it.
Arora really wants to get off strike, Russell sends him back, that was pushed to cover, no run there once Shedge dived and stopped the ball
full ball angling into the right-hander from around the wicket, played to short third
lets it go outside off, Russell wants the wide but isn't going to get it. Punjab have a crack at Arora now.

width offered outside off stump and Russell shows off all that power, slapping the ball hard and flat through cover and into the gap on the boundary, it was near Arshdeep in the infield but it was hit so hard he had no chance
Russell is in the mood tonight! Clears his front foot and slams the ball high and far over the cow corner boundary, two of the six sixes done with!
defended watchfully back to the bowler
has he got it? No, just clears the leaping fielder on the long off boundary! Jansen was the man there and he's the tallest of the lot. Russell hit that flat and hard, and just high enough
that was nearly it for Punjab! Russell went for the big shot and got an inside edge just past his stumps
Vaibhav Arora defends a full and straight ball back to the bowler

chopped on! The crowd in new Chandigarh are seeing a minor miracle! Rana falls to the third successive short ball. He tries to ster it to deep third once again and gets a bottom edge that uproots off stump
and again! Tries to upper cut the short one coming at his head this time and misses once again
short ball, angling into the right-hander from over the wicket, Rana sways out of the line to avoid the ball and then tries to ramp, beaten
played off the back foot to backward point
short of a length angling into the body, Jansen's back by the way. Nudged softly in front of square and they sprint back for the second run
played back to the bowler
pushed off the back foot towards point for a single

what on earth is going on here?! Incredible scenes. Chahal bowls a loopy full toss, Ramandeep tries to paddle sweep and Shreyas runs around from first slip towards leg slip to take the catch! He anticipated that beautifully.

Chahal takes off on a celebratory run after foxing Rinku! Is he turning his season around? Is he turning this match around? Chahal draws Rinku forward and out of his crease with one that drifts across the left-hander from over the wicket, the ball then pitches short of the batter and spins back through the gap between bat and pad, Inglis collects and whips off the bails. Just beautiful bowling.
tossed up on middle stump, inviting Russell to go after it, he shows restraint and drives along the ground to long on
bowled flat and a bit short, Rinku goes back and hits it to long on
another front foot defence from Russell, played back to the bowler
blocked off the front foot, bat close to front pad

huge huge appeal for lbw and the umpire finally raises the finger! Will Venky review? He does! Maxwell angled the ball into the left-hander from around the wicket, Venky got down on one knee to sweep, having planted his front foot right across his stumps. No bat on the ball. He was hit on the knee roll. That's hitting. Three reds. KKR are five down.
punched to long off for a single
backs away to cut the ball angling into him from around the wicket but can't beat point
goes right back and works the ball off the pads in front of square leg
steps out and then defends, gets hit on the pad by one that spins back into the left-hander ... no runs in the over after the wide first ball
defended from the crease once again
pushed through quick on a wicket to wicket line, Rinku defends on the off side
nudged off the front foot towards the bowler
appeal for lbw but that is missing leg, Rinku tried to defend it from his crease

caught at backward point! Raghuvanshi backs away towards leg and looks to go inside out through covers, the length is shorter than ideal for that shot and the turn away from him takes the outside edge, the ball flew flat and low and Bartlett leans forward to take a low catch
slides down leg side, Inglis whips off the bails but the back foot is safely grounded
nudged off the pads towards square leg for a single
tries to sweep from outside off but doesn't make proper contact
goes right back and defends on the off side
defended on the off side near the keeper
strides forward and drives the ball through cover point
worked off the pads for a single through square leg
driven to long off for a single

what's happened there?!! Venky swept the ball to long leg, Barlett ran to his left and picked up the ball cleanly, and then as he shaped to throw it back towards the pitch the ball slipped out of his hand and went to the boundary. Punjab's boundary fielding a bit of a shambles tonight. And because he was throwing that ball when it slipped out of his hands, it's been counted as four overthrows, in addition to the single they ran.

lbw! Rahane misses the slog sweep and is pinned on the back leg. He's walking, and then decides to chat with Raghuvanshi, and then continues walking. Oh that might have made for a good review? That ball pitched around off, and Rahane's back foot was on off stump when the ball hit him. Let's see what ball tracking has to say ... impact was outside off stump, Rahane should have reviewed!
bowled slowly outside off, Rahane strides forward and defends, a bit of drift and turn for Chahal there
bowled full and straight, driven to long on for a single
played to short third for a single
worked off the pads to deep square leg for a single
fuller and wide outside off stump, driven on the front foot to deep cover
short ball again, gets high on Rahane who meets it with the pull, hitting it against the angle across him from over the wicket to the fielder at deep midwicket on the bounce
short of a length and closer to the body, Raghuvanshi stays back and dabs to third man
short of a length outside off, cut off the back foot to the man at deep point
banged in short, Rahane ducks under it
driven uppishly but through the gap between extra cover and mid-off, that wasn't too far away to Jansen's left at extra cover
tries to flick the ball this time but gets a leading edge that flies in the air over the fielder at point, the fielder on the sweeper boundary can't get to it in time
over deep midwicket, this time it's young Raghuvanshi, lofting the full ball clean off his pads with a free swing of his bat
moves forward and across to turn a fullish ball off his pads through midwicket, Chahal dives over the ball and can't prevent it
defended into the covers on the front foot
full and straight delivery, Rahane lays into it with a lofted checked drive and times it perfectly all the way for six over the bowler's head
short ball, Raghuvanshi had backed away outside leg stump and ended up letting it go
full on the pads, glanced past the keeper off the pads and that's speeding towards the boundary, Chahal tries to dive and save but is unsuccessful
played towards mid on

oh no, Shashank's not having a good night in the field. He was chasing Raghuvanshi's punch off the back foot through covers, he ended up sliding to try and save the ball, knocked the boundary cushions back, and then couldn't prevent the ball from rolling on to the cushions anyway
angles across the right-hander on a length from over the wicket, Rahane runs it down to third man from his crease
short of a length at the hips, nudged through square leg for a single
poor fielding on the long leg boundary, Shashank ran to his right to try and cut off Rahane's swing off the pads but got done by the spin to his left and conceded the four
pushed off the front foot straight to the fielder at point
good length, angling towards the off stump, Raghuvanshi strides forward and plays the ball behind point with angled bat
Rahane stays in his crease and dabs the ball behind point for a single
driven on the up from a good length outside off stump to mid off
good length on middle and off, Rahane calmly defends on the front foot
short of a length, angling into the right-hander and straightening a touch off the pitch with steep bounce, Raghuvanshi tries to run it to deep third but is beaten
so close! Could have bowled him. Raghuvanshi was cramped by the angle into him from around the wicket and ended up defending the ball past his stumps
wider line outside off from around the wicket, Raghuvanshi reaches for it but is beaten on the cut shot
gives him the charge this time and cuts the short of a length ball flat over the infield at cover point for consecutive boundaries
shot! Uses the width on offer outside of, gets down on one knee and laces the square drive through point

Raghuvanshi drives inside the line at a fuller ball angling across him, he was perhaps playing for the left-armer's movement into the right-hander but this one slanted across and beat the outside edge
clipped gently off the pads towards midwicket, what a frenetic start to the chase!
fuller ball outside off, driven crisply on the front foot to cover
played to midwicket this time

he's misjudged it on the third man boundary! Shedge was off the line this time, and had to run back and to his right to try and get to the ball, in the end it fell over his head and bounced just inside the boundary. Raghuvanshi had charged his first ball and looked to launch it over extra cover, ended up slicing it instead

do we have a game on here tonight? QDK falls early too. Not that full this time, again on the pads, and this time QDK connects, hoisting the ball high high into the air, Shedge lines it up on the long leg boundary and judges the catch superbly
huge appeal for lbw after QDK misses the flick and gets hit on the pad by a full ball, that swung back into the left-hander and was likely missing leg stump

bowled him! The leg bail is in place but the off bail takes a beating. Jansen shortens the length again and angles the ball into the left-hander from over the wicket, Narine clears his front foot and swipes across the line and misses, the ball clips the top of off stump
follows up with a fuller ball in line with the stumps, Narine clears his front foot towards the leg side and drives the ball in the air flat and hard over covers
short and wide outside off, Narine lets it go, called a bouncer
was looking to play that on the off side but got an inside edge behind square on the leg
fuller length on the pads, Narine chips it in the air towards deep square leg, gets to the fielder on the first bounce
short of a length with width outside off, QDK chops it into the ground on the off side and runs the single
